LanguageData.FB_ColonyBrain_Structure_GestationOrgano: A brood organ that holds a living donor and grows offspring of its kind from hemogel. The donor is consumed and cannot be recovered.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidSelectDonorDesc: Choose a living donor to seal inside the birthing sac. Downed unfactioned creatures are carried here by haulers; factioned pawns walk in on their own. Anything placed inside is lost permanently.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDonorLostWarning: {0} will be sealed inside the gestation organoid permanently. The donor cannot be released, dies once its reserves are spent, and is destroyed if the organoid is deconstructed. Continue?
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDonorNotOrganic: Only organic creatures can gestate. Mechanoids and drones are rejected.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDonorAnomalous: Anomalous entities do not breed and cannot be used as donors.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDonorGenderless: Only creatures with a gender can be used as donors.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDonorNotAdult: Only adult creatures can be used as donors.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDonorMustBeDowned: An unfactioned donor must be downed first.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidStartCycleDesc: Begin growing a new body from the sealed donor. Produces: {0}.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidCancelCycleDesc: Abort the current growth cycle. All progress is lost, but the donor's remaining births are not spent.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidCycleRunning: A growth cycle is already running.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidConfigureXenotypeDes: Compose the xenotype of the next offspring from genepacks stored in the colony's genome archive. Saved xenotypes can be loaded and stored.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidPausedNoHemogel: Growth paused: no hemogel network supply.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidIdleInspect: Idle. Order it to grow a body.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidBirthFailed: The organoid failed to shape a viable body.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidBirthLetterText: The gestation organoid has pushed out {0}, grown from the reserves of {1}.\n\nThe donor has {2} births left.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDonorSpentLetterText: {0} has been drained of everything the organoid could use. The husk dissolves inside the birthing sac.
LanguageData.FB_GestationOrganoidDevFinishDesc: Complete the current growth cycle instantly.
LanguageData.FB_XenotypeSaveNeedsName: The xenotype needs a name before it can be saved.
LanguageData.FB_XenotypeLoadMissingGenes: The archive has no genepacks for: {0}.
